documents.title: GenAI Guidance for Instructors (2025)
documents.summary: The Berkeley Academic Senate working group gives faculty arguments for prohibiting, allowing or requiring GenAI, three sample syllabus statements (Full AI, Some AI, No AI), and implementation advice on access, citation and enforcement. It leaves the choice to each instructor and recommends a syllabus statement.
